extracted.name: Protein Packed Crustless Quiche
extracted.description: Protein is king in my house. Quick and easy recipes also reign for me. Taste has to be top priority. Put that all together and you have a delicious, easy, nutritious meal. This can work for breakfast, brunch or dinner. Play with your favorite veggies to incorporate.
ingredient_lines: 24 ounce container low fat cottage cheese
8 ounce bag frozen spinach, cooked and squeezed of all liquid
instruction_lines: Use the olive oil to grease a 9.5 " pie plate. Set aside.
Cook and squeeze the liquid out of frozen spinach.
In a large bowl, combine the rest of the ingredients. Thoroughly mix to make sure eggs get completely mixed in.
Bake in a preheated oven set to 350 degrees fahrenheit.
Cook for 45-60 minutes or until set and lightly browned on top.
